quality_assessment: Content is accurate and comprehensive, but lacks visual enhancements consistent with other advanced-patterns pages. No technical drift, but missing educational features that would improve user understanding.

issues.description: Page lacks decision flow diagram for engine selection. Other pages in advanced-patterns/ use Mermaid diagrams to illustrate decision-making processes (see backreferences.md and examples.md).
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a Mermaid flowchart showing when to use default vs PCRE2 vs auto engine, similar to the decision flow in examples.md. This would help users understand the tradeoffs between --engine=default, --engine=pcre2, and --engine=auto.

issues.description: Code examples lack inline annotations. Other pages use MkDocs Material code annotations (# (1)! style) to explain command-line options inline.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add code annotations to examples explaining what each flag does. For example, in line 16: 'rg -P 'foo(?=bar)'' could have annotations explaining -P flag and lookahead syntax.

issues.description: Section 'Tradeoffs' mentions predictable performance and error messages but doesn't explain WHY these differences exist (finite automata vs backtracking).
issues.current_content: Lines 93-102: Mentions tradeoffs but not the underlying technical reasons
issues.should_be: Add brief explanation that default engine uses finite automata (linear time, predictable), while PCRE2 uses backtracking (potentially exponential, more features)
issues.fix_suggestion: Expand the Tradeoffs section to explain the algorithmic differences: default engine = DFA/finite automata (O(n) time), PCRE2 = backtracking (potentially O(2^n) with worst-case patterns). This context helps users understand the performance implications.

issues.description: Section mentions lookahead/lookbehind and backreferences but doesn't link to dedicated pages for these topics
issues.current_content: Lines 46-54: Mentions features without linking to detailed documentation
issues.fix_suggestion: Add cross-references to lookaround.md and backreferences.md when mentioning these features. Example: 'Lookahead or lookbehind assertions (see [Lookaround](./lookaround.md))' and 'Backreferences for matching repeated patterns (see [Backreferences](./backreferences.md))'.

issues.description: Warning about cryptic PCRE2 errors uses bold text instead of MkDocs Material admonition. Other pages use admonition boxes for warnings.
issues.current_content: Line 58: '**Warning**: PCRE2 provides less helpful error messages...'
issues.should_be:
!!! warning "PCRE2 Error Messages"
    PCRE2 provides less helpful error messages than the default engine. If you get cryptic errors, try your pattern with the default engine first to debug.
issues.fix_suggestion: Convert the bold warning to a proper MkDocs Material admonition box for visual consistency with backreferences.md and other pages.
